name: Hōchō Kyōshitsu
description: Hōchō Kyōshitsu — A washoku cooking school theme built as a card mosaic in gunjō ultramarine (#4C6CB3), the main colour on the hero card, every page head, the header bar and the footer, over washi-textured pale paper with sumi indigo ink; Yuji Syuku brush display over Albert Sans. The art is pencil-sketch raster illustration (graphite hatching with ultramarine pencil accents): a yanagiba knife on a hinoki board and a whole sea bream as transparent cut-outs that break out of their cards, plus a dashi pot, a katsuramuki lesson, a bento and the school kitchen. A full top header: one ultramarine bar with the school name, the menu and a Book a class button. The home page is a mosaic of cards: the large ultramarine title card with a vertical Japanese spine and the cut-out knife crossing its edge, class cards, the sea bream swimming over the four-week course card, the synced fees card and the journal. The fees card and the school details are synced patterns edited in one place. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b3-12 (card-mosaic, cutout-break-frame-object hero, top-bar nav, collage images, pencil-sketch illustration, 群青 #4C6CB3, Yuji Syuku + Albert Sans). Contrast: white on gunjō #4C6CB3 5.1:1 (body text on the ultramarine fields), persimmon #FFC98B on gunjō 3.4:1 (large display text only), sumi ink #151C33 on paper #F3F5FA 15.5:1, deep ultramarine #2D4A8E on paper 7.8:1, white on deep #2D4A8E 8.5:1, slate #46506B on white 8.0:1, ink on mist #DCE3F2 13.1:1.

fonts.role: display: headings, the school name, prices, the vertical Japanese spine and the footer mark

summary.zh-TW: 鉛筆素描風的和食料理教室網站：群青色卡片拼貼，去背的柳刃刀與鯛魚破框而出，搭配課程與學費卡片。
summary.en: A pencil-sketch washoku cooking school site: an ultramarine card mosaic with a cut-out knife and sea bream breaking their frames beside class and fee cards.
summary.ja: 鉛筆スケッチ風の和食料理教室サイト。群青のカードモザイクから切り抜きの柳刃包丁と鯛が枠を越え、講座と料金のカードが並びます。
summary.fr: Un site d’école de cuisine washoku au crayon : une mosaïque de cartes outremer d’où le couteau et la daurade détourés débordent, avec les cours et les tarifs.
summary.de: Eine Washoku-Kochschule im Bleistiftstil: ein ultramarines Kartenmosaik, aus dem ausgeschnittenes Messer und Meerbrasse ragen, mit Kursen und Preisen.
